description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow the extention of the canopy and an additional single entrance along the front elevation of planning permission 00505/G1/P6 for the variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for an additional entrance to existing building of planning permission 00505/G1/P5 dated 01/03/2023 for change of use from Class E office to Class F1 an educational facility
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission  00505/G1/P5 dated 1 March 2023

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 3141.PLN.BSP.300, 3141.PLN.BSP.301, 3141.PLN.BSP.302, 3141.PLN.BSP.303, 3141.PLN.BSP.304, 3141.PLN.BSP.305, 3141.PLN.BSP.306, 3141.PLN.BSP.307, 3141.PLN.BSP.308, 3141.PLN.BSP.310 received 19 June 2023; and shall conform in all other respects to the drawings and documentations approved under planning permission  00505/G1/P6: 3141.PLN.BSP.209, 3141.PLN.BSP.210, 3141.PLN.BSP.211 received 19 May 2023 and 00505/G1/P5: 3141.PLN.BSP.102, 3141.PLN.BSP.103, Planning Statement, Report in Respect of Market Demand,  Fire Compliance Statement received 5 January 2023
Condition : 3 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the Framework Travel Plan as approved under 00505/G1/P5(3-4)

Condition : 4 - Cycle parking shall be implemented in accordance with 3141.PLN.BSP.207 Rev A as approved under 00505/G1/P5(3-4). 
The facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
